info.title: Agenteca Server
info.description: Catalog of AI agents: search, package content before installation, publication, export to native marketplaces.

source.description: Reference that "ahub add" can install (OpenAPM form), pinned to the latest version when it is tagged.

repository.description: Reference of the repository, without a version.

license.description: SPDX identifier declared by the package.

nativePlugin.description: The repository also has the layout of a native plugin.

post.description: The token is returned only once: only its hash is kept.

put.summary: Gives a user a role in a catalog

delete.summary: Removes a member from a catalog

get.summary: Exports the catalog in the native marketplace format of a tool
get.description: Produces the content of `.claude-plugin/marketplace.json` (Claude Code), `.agents/plugins/marketplace.json` (Codex), `.github/plugin/marketplace.json` (Copilot CLI) or `.cursor-plugin/marketplace.json` (Cursor). By default, only the packages that are also native plugins are exported.

schema.description: Also includes the packages that are not native plugins.
Words looked for in the name, the description and the tags.

allOf.description: Keeps only the packages compatible with this tool.

post.summary: Adds a repository to the catalog (editor)
post.description: Reads the tags and the manifests of the repository, indexes the versions and their content, and scans each version. No code from the repository is executed.

source.description: OpenAPM reference of the repository: `owner/repo`, `host/owner/repo/subfolder` or a git URL.

delete.summary: Removes a package from the catalog (admin)

post.summary: Reads the repository of a package again (editor)

get.summary: Content of a version: primitives, files, scan findings
Text of a file, to read it before installing

schema.description: Path of the file in the package.
